title: 第6章 求仙问道之心
slug: 道君全本免费-道君最新章节列表
content_zh:
眼巴巴看着人家走了，确认人家的确是走了，牙关打颤的牛有道费力地爬上了竹排。
不出来还好，一出水吹着冷风，那叫一个酸爽，更冷，浑身直哆嗦，牙关喀喀喀个不停，又冷又饿。他真想跳回水里去，也许更暖和一点，可他知道那和温水煮青蛙没什么区别，一旦发现不对，估计再也没办法从水里爬上来。
摸出火折子想烤火，结果发现火折子也湿透了，没法用。
瞅到扔竹排上还没啃几口的烤鱼，赶紧抓了起来，僵硬着十指捧在手里哆嗦着咬，想办法补充能量，身体热量好像已经消耗的没了，那是从骨子里冷出来的劲，人感觉都要冻僵了，四周明显是荒郊野外，看不到人烟迹象求救。
后来发现不行，整个人的知觉似乎都有些发木，昏昏沉沉想睡。
他清晰的知道，不能睡，这是自我麻木，身体这种状况一旦睡着就别想醒来。
目光投向了河岸，想靠岸上岸，可身体已经冻僵了，身不由己，意识不由自主地渐渐沉沦。
就在他即将陷入昏睡的刹那，似乎做梦靠在了一个火炉上，后背发烫，又猛然惊醒过来。
哧溜爬起，愣住，发现身上湿漉漉的棉衣正冒着腾腾热气。
身上也不冷了，后背某个部位更是热的发烫，滚滚热流不断导向四肢百骸，驱散了所有寒意。
之前是冻僵的感觉，现在却渐渐有热的发燥的感觉。
对此也只是稍微奇怪了一下，随后若有所思，背部那个热源正是东郭浩然给他打入了护身符的穴位，这么一想就明白了，同时也觉得匪夷所思，东郭浩然的内力驾驭居然如此神奇？这越发激发了他想去上清宗看看的念头，说是求仙问道之心也不为过。
热的难受，他想调息引导这股热流，但这身体还没那本钱，没有起码的运功根基，体内没有引导的真气，无法行气，靠空想是没用的。
其次也不知道自己这身体适不适合修炼，套用修行中人的话，那就是根骨，并不是所有人都适合练气，实际上大部分人都不适合。问题的原因出在每个人的身体状况不同，练气对身体经络的分布要求较高，经络就像是人身体内部的枝干，人身体内的主枝干大同小异，旁通的枝干却未必相同，就好比同样种类的树木，长出的形状却未必一样。
有些人甚至连体内经络的主枝干都未必会相同，连心脏长在另一边胸腔的人都有。
根骨不行，也就是身体条件不行的人，也不是不能练气，但只能修炼一些简单的气功，可延年益寿之类的吐纳之术，那些高深的、对行气条件要求较复杂的修炼功法是没办法修炼的。
最后，实在是有点热的不行，牛有道又用冷水扑面，甚至解开了衣襟吹冷风，身上破棉袄依旧在冒热气，皮肤通红。
清理竹排上箭羽的时候，牛有道注意到了女将射来的那面铭牌，不大，暗红色的圆圆一块，一面雕刻了一只展翅翱翔的凤凰，一面刻了个‘男’字。
“小篆…”盯着字体嘀咕了一声，眼神中透着茫然。
这里人用的字体居然是小篆？凭他曾经干过的行当，对小篆字体自然不陌生，能轻易辨读。

让他疑惑的是，这个世界的人说着普通话，字体却用着小篆，与他熟知的世界显得有些杂乱，可反过来想，站在这个世界的角度来看他来的那个世界，也许是他熟知的那个世界杂乱，究竟是哪边乱，他也不知道答案，茫然不解。
而竹排也已经进入了山川激流之中，漂流的速度飞快，开始颠簸起伏。
回过神来的牛有道赶紧将竹排后面的一连串捕鱼小机关给收了，路途较远，后面说不定还能派上用场，不能毁在了这复杂水路上。竹篙已经在手，在湍急的峡谷河流中左撑右支，敞开衣襟迎着寒风在不时溅起的浪花中与风浪搏击，动作娴熟，他显然有这方面的驾驭经验，处变不惊，场面波澜壮阔又惊心动魄。
过了险滩，水流又平缓了下来，牛有道已累瘫，抓了竹排上的一只死鱼生吃，山峦上空一轮明月。
颇有两岸猿声啼不尽，轻舟已过万重山的味道，竹排流出山脉，旭日金霞出了地平线，也找了个地方靠岸。

content_en:
Watching the people leave helplessly, and confirming that they were indeed gone, Niu Youdao, with trembling teeth, climbed up the bamboo raft with great effort.
It was okay not to come out, but when I came out of the water, the cold wind blew, which made me feel sour and even colder. I was shivering all over, my teeth kept clicking, I felt cold and hungry. He really wanted to jump back into the water, maybe it would be warmer, but he knew that it would be no different from boiling a frog in warm water. Once he found something wrong, he would probably never be able to climb out of the water again.
I took out the huozhezi to warm up the fire, but found that the huozhezi was also soaked and couldn't be used.
I saw the grilled fish on the bamboo raft that I hadn't even taken a few bites of, so I quickly grabbed it, holding it with trembling fingers and biting it, trying to find a way to replenish energy. The heat in my body seemed to have been exhausted. It was the cold energy coming from the bones. I felt like I was about to freeze. It was obviously a wilderness and there was no sign of people calling for help.
Later, I found out that it didn't work. My whole consciousness seemed to be a little dull, and I felt drowsy and wanted to sleep.
He clearly knew that he couldn't sleep, it was self-numbing, and once his body was in this condition, he couldn't even think of waking up.
He cast his eyes on the river bank and wanted to go ashore, but his body was already frozen and he couldn't help it, and his consciousness gradually sank involuntarily.
Just when he was about to fall into sleep, he seemed to be leaning against a stove in a dream, his back felt hot, and he woke up suddenly.
Chi Liu got up and was stunned to find that the wet cotton clothes on his body were steaming.
The body is no longer cold, and a certain part of the back is even hotter. The billowing heat flow is continuously directed to the limbs, dispelling all the chill.
It used to be a freezing feeling, but now it's gradually getting hot and dry.
I was just a little surprised by this, and then I thought about it. The heat source on my back was the acupuncture point where Dong Guo Haoran inserted the amulet into him. When I thought about it, I understood it. At the same time, I felt incredible. Dong Guo Haoran's control of internal power was so magical? This more and more inspired him to want to visit the Shangqing Sect. It would not be an exaggeration to say that he had a desire to seek immortality.
The heat was unbearable, and he wanted to adjust his breath to guide this heat flow, but his body didn't have the capital, and he didn't have a basic foundation for movement. There was no guided Qi in his body, so he couldn't move Qi. It was useless to rely on fantasy.
Secondly, I don’t know if my body is suitable for practicing Qi. To paraphrase practitioners, it’s just the bones. Not everyone is suitable for practicing Qi. In fact, most people are not suitable. The reason for the problem is that everyone's physical condition is different. Qi training has higher requirements on the distribution of the body's meridians. The meridians are like the branches inside the human body. The main branches in the human body are similar, but the bypass branches may not be the same. Just like the same type of trees, they may not grow in the same shape.
Some people may not even have the same main branches of meridians in their body, and there are even people whose heart is on the other side of their chest.
People with weak bones, that is, people with poor physical conditions, are not unable to practice qi, but they can only practice some simple qigong, such as breathing and breathing techniques that can extend life and so on. Those advanced exercises that require more complicated qi conditions cannot be practiced.
Finally, it was really too hot, so Niu Youdao splashed cold water on his face again, and even untied his clothes to blow in the cold wind. The tattered cotton jacket on his body was still steaming, and his skin was red.
While cleaning the arrow feathers on the bamboo raft, Niu Youdao noticed the nameplate that the female general had shot. It was small, dark red and round, with a soaring phoenix carved on one side and the word 'male' on the other.
"Xiao Zhuan..." He muttered while staring at the font, his eyes filled with confusion.
The font used by people here is Xiaozhuan? Based on his previous work, he was no stranger to Xiaozhuan script and could read it easily.
What puzzled him was that people in this world spoke Mandarin, but the fonts were in Xiaozhuan, which seemed a bit messy with the world he knew well. But on the other hand, looking at the world he came from from the perspective of this world, maybe it was the world he was familiar with.The world was in chaos. He didn't know the answer to where the chaos was. He was at a loss.
The bamboo raft has also entered the rapids of the mountains and rivers. It is drifting very fast and begins to bump up and down.
After coming back to his senses, Niu Youdao quickly closed the series of small fishing traps behind the bamboo rafts. The road was far away and they might come in handy later, so they couldn't be ruined on this complicated waterway. With the bamboo pen already in his hand, he was leaning left and right in the rapid canyon river. He opened his clothes to face the cold wind and fought against the waves that splashed from time to time. His movements were skillful. He obviously had experience in driving in this area. He was calm at every turn. The scene was magnificent and thrilling.
After passing the dangerous shoal, the current calmed down again. Niu Youdao was paralyzed from exhaustion. He caught a dead fish on the bamboo raft and ate it alive. There was a bright moon over the mountains.
It feels like the endless cries of apes on both sides of the strait, the boat has passed the Ten Thousand Mountains, the bamboo rafts flow out of the mountains, the golden glow of the rising sun has risen above the horizon, and I have found a place to dock.
